says: A person binds this device's key and the checkout, and registers two sources of the repository: a knowledge source for domain material and a memory source for decisions. From one observed span of a session transcript, a packaged local adapter makes two typed captures: a knowledge capture of one domain member, stored as a draft for the knowledge source, and a memory capture of one entry, stored as a draft for the memory source; a candidate choice extracted from the memory capture is stored as a candidate for the memory source. Each enters its own role's path. None of it becomes an always instruction or accepted current memory: a knowledge capture that also carries behavioural units is refused at admission (a knowledge capture has no field for a unit); a projection to the Instructions role that pins the knowledge source is refused with role_promotion_refused and nothing is projected; and the current state of the memory source, resolved after the candidate is stored, has no entry and no frontier, because nothing was accepted there.
